answer:
At 10 bar(a), ammonia boils at about 298.06 K (24.9 °C), and its latent heat of vaporisation there is about 1166 kJ/kg (≈ 19.9 kJ/mol, using M = 17.031 g/mol).

I worked this out with CoolProp 8.0.0, using its reference equation of state for ammonia. It is the saturated vapour enthalpy minus the saturated liquid enthalpy at P = 10 bar: h_v − h_l = 1166.2 kJ/kg.

I didn't check this against a second source such as NIST WebBook or a steam-table-style ammonia table.
